title: Served digest
description: What a record serves for one hashed object: the exact RFC 8785 canonical bytes, as a string, and SHA-256 over UTF-8(domain), one line feed and UTF-8(canonical). A verifier hashes the served bytes; it needs no canonicalizer of its own.

domain.description: Type and version of the hashed object, e.g. dev.writesafety.tiny-tracker/execution-result/1.

canonical.description: The canonical bytes that were hashed (RFC 8785).

digest.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 over UTF-8(domain) || 0x0A || UTF-8(canonical).
